Implementation is complete and verified. Handing back to the Shiki loop for delivery (I have not committed, pushed, or opened a PR — those are loop-owned).

## Result
- Goal/task: G-20260806T084356214001Z-8198f059 / T-20260806T084356215508Z-7a7dd694
- Role: Implementer (Claude Code, ADR 0008)
- Status: **complete** (implementation + tests green; awaiting loop delivery → CCA → MergeGate)

## What changed
- **`scripts/shiki_tasks.py`** — added `cmd_lock_release` (the deliberate counterpart to `cmd_lock_acquire`) + `FINISHED_TASK_STATUSES`. It is the *authority* for a release: decides "finished" from the task record (terminal status `done` only — I discovered "retired/abandoned/superseded" aren't real statuses; the motivating "retired" task is actually `planned`), refuses an unfinished task naming the task and its status, treats an already-released lock as a no-op success, refuses a missing/unreadable record naming the path, and **marks** the record (`state→released` + `released_by`/`released_at` alongside the acquisition fields) rather than deleting it. Record shape + JSON result contract mirror acquire.
- **`scripts/shiki_cli.py`** — imported `cmd_lock_release` and wired the `release` child into the `lock` subparser (mirrors `acquire`: `--target`, `--owner`, `task_id`).
- **`tests/test_lock_release.py`** — 11 unit tests (TDD): finished-release records the releaser; result contract mirrors acquire; released paths acquirable by a different task; unfinished refused (all 6 non-terminal statuses); missing/unreadable refused naming path; already-released no-op (fresh + re-run); dispatch and status-promotion never release; and a drift-guard binding `FINISHED_TASK_STATUSES` to `validate_shiki.TERMINAL_TASK_STATUSES`.
- **`scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh`** — self-contained end-to-end block proving the property unit tests can't: a DIFFERENT task acquires the SAME paths after release (blocked-before, granted-after), plus a validation-pass-never-releases assertion. Cleans up all temp task/lock/ledger files before the closing `validate_shiki`.
